Field notes · October

Autumn at the footbridge

What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

We recommend raising the deck by one course before the spring melt. The cost is modest and the work can be done in two days with the water low.

The path

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

  • "rose twice that week"

    MLMaya Lindqvist5m ago

    Two days is optimistic. Last time the same job took a week; say so, or give a range.

  • Pin · under The path

This screen

See every comment in one place

Open in prototypereview.html#all-comments

Show every thread on the page in one panel beside it, with the words each is about, so Maya can go through them in order and find the ones for her.

Persona at this step
MLMaya Lindqvist

Maya has three threads scattered down the page and wants to see them together before she copies them. She opens All comments from the menu.

Content
  • The panel on the right, the full height of the window; the page moves over to make room and nothing is covered.
  • Its top line: two filters, @ For you and ✓ Resolved, both off, and Close at the end. No title.
  • The list, in page order: for each thread the words it is about in one line ("rose twice that week", "Paragraph · We recommend raising the deck", "Pin · under The path"), then its card. The second card is opened out in place with its reply box.
Show 2 more
  • The footer, which the comment control has turned into: her avatar and name, Comment with its switch and ⇧⌥C, and ⋯.
  • With For you on and nothing mentioning her (empty): the list gives way to one line, "No comments mention you".
Wording
  • No comments mention you For you is on and no thread mentions her.
  • No resolved comments Resolved is on and none is resolved.
  • No comments yet there is no thread at all.
Components
Comment card openComments panelPopover menu iconAvatar smButton primary, quietChip filterHighlightIcon button quietKeyPinSwitchText field
States
  • EmptyFor you on with no mentions: "No comments mention you"; with no threads at all the list reads "No comments yet" and the footer still offers Comment.
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorNot applicable
Interactions
  • Opening slides the panel in from the right over --ds-motion-settle while the page eases narrower; closing (Close, or Esc after any open thread) reverses it and focus returns to the comment control.
  • A thread open on the page moves into the panel; while the panel is open nothing opens beside the page. Choosing a card opens it out in place and reveals where it is: the page scrolls there and its words are marked; choosing the open card's top line, or Esc, closes it.
  • For you shows only threads that mention her; Resolved brings resolved threads back, muted, each with Reopen. A filter turns on and off with a colour change over --ds-motion-quick; the cards fade in and out over --ds-motion-settle.
Show 3 more
  • Resolve on a card eases it out of the list unless Resolved is on. The footer's switch turns comment mode on and off; ⋯ opens the rest of the menu.
  • A click on the page never closes the panel: in comment mode it picks something to comment on, and a new comment is written in the panel, where it falls in page order.
  • On narrow screens the panel takes the full width and each open card keeps the words it is about.
Requirements
  • FR-010 All comments lists every thread in page order with the words it is about, filters it to mentions and to resolved threads, opens each thread in place and reveals where it is on the page, and the page moves over so the panel covers nothing.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-all-comments-1FR-010PassedGiven three threads, when Maya opens All comments, then a panel on the right lists the three in page order, each with the words it is about, and the page's content is narrower but all still visible.
  2. AC-all-comments-2FR-010PassedGiven the panel open, when she chooses the second card, then it opens out in place with its reply box and the page scrolls to its paragraph.
  3. AC-all-comments-3FR-010PassedGiven the panel open, when she turns on For you, then the list reads "No comments mention you", and turning it off brings the three back.
  4. AC-all-comments-4FR-010PassedGiven the panel open, when she presses Esc, then the panel closes and focus is on the comment control.

This screen

Bring resolved threads back

Open in prototypereview.html#show-resolved

Show Maya the threads that were resolved, muted among the open ones, so she can check what was settled and reopen one.

Persona at this step
MLMaya Lindqvist

A thread was resolved too soon. Maya opens All comments and turns on ✓ Resolved to find it.

Content
  • The panel open with ✓ Resolved on: the list holds the open threads and, among them in page order, the resolved one, muted, its time ending "· resolved" and Reopen in place of Resolve.
  • The page beside it unchanged: the resolved thread's card and mark are not on the page.
Wording
  • {time} · resolved the time line of a resolved thread.
  • No resolved comments Resolved is on and none is resolved.
Components
Comment cardComments panelPopover menu iconAvatar smButton quietChip filterHighlightIcon button quietKeyPinSwitch
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorNot applicable
Interactions
  • ✓ Resolved turns on with a colour change over --ds-motion-quick; the resolved cards fade into the list over --ds-motion-settle, and out again when it is turned off.
  • Reopen on a resolved card brings the thread back on the page and in every copy, with "Reopened." beside the tag.
  • A resolved thread can be opened out and read like any other; its reply box still works.
Requirements
  • FR-015 With Resolved on, All comments lists resolved threads among the open ones, muted and marked resolved, each with Reopen.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-show-resolved-1FR-015PassedGiven one resolved thread and the panel open, when Maya turns on Resolved, then the list shows four threads in page order with the resolved one marked "· resolved" and offering Reopen.Set up: the all-comments screen, then Resolve on the pin thread.
  2. AC-show-resolved-2FR-015PassedGiven Resolved on, when she turns it off, then the resolved thread leaves the list and the open three remain.
Prompt for this screen

This journey

Go through every comment

Maya opens All comments to see every thread on the page in one list, narrows it to the ones for her or the resolved ones, and jumps to each place.

Goal
Maya goes through every thread on the page in order without hunting for them, and finds the ones that need her.
Trigger
She comes back to the page later, or there are more threads than fit beside the text, or someone mentioned her.
Outcome
She has read every thread, answered the ones for her, and knows which are resolved.
Success
Every open thread is reachable from the panel, including ones whose place is hidden or gone (FR-010). Choosing a thread shows where it is on the page without covering it.
